faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about OneSign

faq1.question: How long does it take to implement OneSign?
faq1.answer: Most organizations can complete basic implementation within 1-2 weeks. Our guided setup wizard and comprehensive documentation make the process straightforward. For enterprise deployments with complex requirements, our professional services team provides hands-on assistance.

faq2.question: Is OneSign compliant with industry regulations?
faq2.answer: Yes, OneSign is designed with compliance in mind. We support GDPR, SOC2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS requirements out of the box. Our audit logging and reporting features make compliance verification simple.

faq3.question: Can OneSign integrate with our existing systems?
faq3.answer: Absolutely. OneSign integrates with 100+ enterprise applications including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and more. We support SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SCIM protocols for seamless integration.

faq4.question: What authentication methods does OneSign support?
faq4.answer: OneSign supports a wide range of authentication methods including passwords, TOTP authenticator apps, SMS and email OTP, push notifications, FIDO2 security keys, biometric authentication, and smart cards. You can configure different requirements based on user roles and risk levels.

faq5.question: How does OneSign handle data security?
faq5.answer: Security is our top priority. All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). We use zero-knowledge architecture where possible, employ strict access controls, and undergo regular third-party security audits. Your data is hosted in SOC2 certified data centers.

hero.title: About OneSign
hero.subtitle: We're on a mission to make digital signatures simple, secure, and accessible for everyone.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: OneSign was born out of frustration with complicated, expensive e-signature solutions. In 2018, our founders Sarah and Michael were working on a project that required hundreds of signatures. The existing tools were either too complex, too expensive, or lacking in security features.
story.paragraph2: They decided to build something better. A platform that combined enterprise-grade security with consumer-grade simplicity. Something that small businesses could afford but that enterprises would trust.
story.paragraph3: Today, OneSign is used by over 50,000 businesses worldwide, from solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies. We've processed millions of signatures and saved countless hours of manual work. But we're just getting started.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
items: Name, email address, and contact information
Account credentials and profile information
Documents you upload and electronic signatures
Payment and billing information
Communications with us

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Process transactions and send related information
Send you technical notices and support messages
Respond to your comments and questions
Protect against fraudulent or illegal activity

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
items: With your consent or at your direction
With service providers who perform services on our behalf
To comply with legal obligations
To protect our rights and prevent fraud
In connection with a business transaction

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, access controls, and secure data storage. However, no security system is impenetrable.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.content: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:
items: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
Correct inaccurate personal data
Request deletion of your personal data
Object to or restrict processing
Data portability
Withdraw consent

section6.title: 6. Cookies and Tracking
section6.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing activities. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

section7.title: 7. International Data Transfers
section7.content: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers.

section8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
section8.content: Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

section9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
section9.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.
